parts.label: Part 4
parts.article:
Section 4. You will hear a talk on the research of the graphical symbol.

1st, you have some time to look at questions 31 to 40.

Now listen carefully and answer questions 31 to 40.

Good morning, everyone. Today I'm going to talk about the graphical symbol. A graphic symbol is a written symbol that is used to represent speech, such as those used in the Greek alphabet.

The term graphic symbol encompasses anything from the logographs used in Egyptian hieroglyphic writing to ancient Chinese pictograms.

Early symbols were based on pictographs and ideograms before they were developed into logographic writing systems.

These systems are still in use in some non-literate cultures in Africa, the Americas, and Oceania.

Indeed, elements of pictography are still found in modern Chinese characters, and it is often an interesting exercise to trace the origins of some Chinese characters.

Pictographs remain in common commercial use today as signs, instructions, or statistical diagrams.

Road signs and public toilet signs, and even flat-pack assembly instructions utilizing pictures are considered pictographic.

Ancient graphic writing systems provide researchers with a wealth of knowledge about past civilizations.

In 1799, one of the most important historical discoveries was made by accident when members of Napoleon's expedition to Egypt found a stone in Rosetta that exhibited 3 different scripts.

The stone, now known as the Rosetta Stone, was studied in significant depth by scholars and was 1st deciphered by Frenchman Jean-François Champollion in 1822.

He was able to correctly determine the phonetic values of the symbols, and later research has confirmed his findings.

In many of these symbols, lines are used to portray a multitude of meanings, and knowledge and understanding of these lines holds the key to comprehension of graphic writing systems.

A key moment in the history of communication was the invention of the camera obscura, or camera.

Although the concept can be traced back to the 5th century BC Chinese philosopher Mo Ti, the 1st photographic image was ultimately created in 1826 by Joseph Nicephore Niepce.

Photography, as it was later known, enables researchers to piece together and better understand history.

Today, photography forms a huge part of everyday life, and most publications contain a vast number of photographs.

Photography is used in advertising and is now becoming a way to increase awareness of existing world issues.

For example, animal welfare charities are increasingly using photography to advertise animals that are at high risk of endangerment. Charity workers are sometimes flown to far-flung locations to document the suffering endured by high-risk animals in an attempt to raise human awareness of their consumption activities and how they impact others.

One recent high-profile campaign was undertaken by attaching a camera to the foot of a bird in order to obtain photographs of the animals in their natural habitats and understand how often they come into contact with human waste.

A soon-to-be-released documentary about the suffering of animals on Midway Island shows the full extent to which human consumption is harming animals thousands of miles away from us.

As photography continues to progress, with the use of drones now becoming somewhat commonplace, we should expect more and more objects to be included in the future, expanding the horizon of photography ever further.

Indeed, the downward pressure on traditional media prices means that media companies are being forced to get creative on how to make a profit.

Many have found that the answer to this lies in advertising, and companies are now willing to devote a large portion of their budgets to advertising in newspapers.

By the same token, marketing has become an essential part of a company's business model, often meaning the success or failure of a company.

As a result, much time and money has been pumped into the development of effective branding, with attractive packaging playing a large role in this.

However, many governments are now seen to be cracking down on marketing and packaging in an attempt to protect consumers from being misled.

In particular, tobacco companies are now subject to ever-increasing regulation. For example, in the United Kingdom, legislation is soon to pass preventing any form of branding or differentiation on cigarette packaging in efforts to curb the harmful effects of smoking. Finally, one must not forget the fundamental role that graphic writing systems have had to play in mathematics. Graphs, icons, and diagrams often form the very basis of these branches of academia. Indeed, one needs to look no further than chemistry's periodic table to see a perfect example of graphic writing systems in use today.

That is the end of Section 4. You now have half a minute to check your answers.

groups.contentHtml:
Graphical Symbol
'Graphical symbol'
•   includes the logographs in Egyptian hieroglyphic writing and ancient Chinese pictograms
•   found in Africa, the Americas, and Oceania
•   still has something to do with use today
Ancient graphic writing systems
•   Researchers obtain a wide range of about past civilisations.
•   Rosetta Stone was found in 1799 when members of Napoleon's expedition got to Egypt.
•   Frenchman Jean-François Champollion determined the phonetic values of the symbols in 1822.
•   In those symbols, are used to depict various meanings.
Camera obscura
•    helps people understand history better.
•   Some charities will many endangered species.
•   A camera was tied to one of a bird.

analyses.content: 录音中提到象形文字如今依然在常见的商业用途（commercial use）中保留，直接对应题干的“today”和“use”。
你可能会听到后面的“signs”或“instructions”并想填进去，但这俩词是举例说明用途的具体形式，填进去会导致语法和整体语义不通顺，千万不要忽略了直接修饰“use”的核心词“commercial”。
Pictographs remain in common commercial use today as signs, instructions, or statistical diagrams.
录音里直白地表述了古老的图形书写系统为研究人员提供了大量关于过去文明的知识（knowledge）。
题目要填的是名词，如果你听到了“wealth”要注意，原文是“a wealth of knowledge”（大量的知识），如果只填入“wealth”在题干“a wide range of”后面意思就重复且不合逻辑了，核心词必须是knowledge。
Ancient graphic writing systems provide researchers with a wealth of knowledge about past civilizations.
录音明确指出，在这些符号中，线条（lines）被用来描绘多种含义，直接对应题目里的“depict various meanings”。
注意不要被句子前面的“symbols”干扰，题目问的是在符号里面什么东西被用来表达意思，你需要准确抓取动词“are used to”前面的主语“lines”。
In many of these symbols, lines are used to portray a multitude of meanings, and knowledge and understanding of these lines holds the key to comprehension of graphic writing systems.
录音提到摄影（Photography）能让研究人员拼凑并更好地理解历史，完美对应题干的“helps people understand history better”。
这道题是这一段的小标题总结性填空，你容易在听上一句关于“camera obscura”的悠久历史时没跟上节奏，只要盯紧“understand history”这个明显的信号词，就能抓到句首的主语photography。
Photography, as it was later known, enables researchers to piece together and better understand history.
录音里说到动物福利慈善机构越来越多地使用摄影来宣传（advertise）濒危动物，刚好填入动词advertise。
只有 advertise 才是和原文完全对应的。不能填 document，因为原文 document 后面接的宾语是suffering，和题目并没有一一对应。
For example, animal welfare charities are increasingly using photography to advertise animals that are at high risk of endangerment.
录音清楚地交代了最近的一项活动是将相机绑在鸟的一只脚（foot）上，直接填出部位名称即可。
这句话比较长且干扰信息极多（比如后面的natural habitats），你要牢牢记住题干在问相机绑在了鸟的哪个“部位”，听到“attaching a camera to the...”时就要立刻写下foot，不要被后面的长句带跑。

One recent high-profile campaign was undertaken by attaching a camera to the foot of a bird in order to obtain photographs of the animals in their natural habitats and understand how often they come into contact with human waste.

groups.contentHtml:
More will be included in the future with the development of photography.
Companies would like to invest a lot to advertise in .

analyses.content: 录音提到随着摄影的发展，我们可以期待在未来有越来越多的物体（objects）被包含进来，正好对应题目的“included in the future”。
你可能会把前面提到的“drones”（无人机）当成答案，但无人机是“随着...的使用”这个前提条件，真正未来被包含得更多的是后面的“objects”。

As photography continues to progress, with the use of drones now becoming somewhat commonplace, we should expect more and more objects to be included in the future, expanding the horizon of photography ever further.
录音里说公司现在愿意把预算的一大部分投入到报纸（newspapers）广告中，对应题目的“invest a lot to advertise in”。
这一段前面铺垫了传统媒体价格下降和公司需要盈利，你如果只听大意容易走神，必须紧盯“advertising in”后面的具体媒介，不要错填成前面的“budgets”或“media”。

Indeed, the downward pressure on traditional media prices means that media companies are being forced to get creative on how to make a profit. Many have found that the answer to this lies in advertising, and companies are now willing to devote a large portion of their budgets to advertising in newspapers.
录音提到在有效品牌推广的发展中，有吸引力的包装（packaging）扮演了巨大角色，原文的“attractive”对应题目的“appealing”。
你可能听到前面的“branding”就想写下来，但题目问的是“设计有吸引力的什么东西是有效branding的方式”，紧跟着形容词attractive后面的名词packaging才是正解。
As a result, much time and money has been pumped into the development of effective branding, with attractive packaging playing a large role in this.
录音最后指出，不能忘记图形书写系统在数学（mathematics）领域发挥的基础性作用，直接对应 the subject of ______。
你可能会因为听到最后面的 chemistry (化学) 而动摇并填错，但化学只是紧接着举的一个“现今在使用的完美例子”，最初确立话题“图形系统具有基础性作用”的学科是数学。

Finally, one must not forget the fundamental role that graphic writing systems have had to play in mathematics. Graphs, icons, and diagrams often form the very basis of these branches of academia. Indeed, one needs to look no further than chemistry's periodic table to see a perfect example of graphic writing systems in use today.
